### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 87847a27ce372f80f20d8493efffa8d24eb9f51a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e4b37cf590ffd32fa7b4ac5ad353864ec0ae3bdb` — the merge of head `841a8734bd6092e4132c74d71723f7d819e5fc6e` into base `87847a27ce372f80f20d8493efffa8d24eb9f51a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e4b37cf590ffd32fa7b4ac5ad353864ec0ae3bdb && git checkout e4b37cf590ffd32fa7b4ac5ad353864ec0ae3bdb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 87847a27ce372f80f20d8493efffa8d24eb9f51a 841a8734bd6092e4132c74d71723f7d819e5fc6e && git checkout -B drift-repro 87847a27ce372f80f20d8493efffa8d24eb9f51a && git merge --no-ff 841a8734bd6092e4132c74d71723f7d819e5fc6e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 87847a27ce372f80f20d8493efffa8d24eb9f51a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `841a8734bd6092e4132c74d71723f7d819e5fc6e`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #20920 (body and all 3 comments — the unlock `5918061397`, the claim `5918207557`, the `os-dev-report` `5919178337`); on #20313 the ruling `5916202706`, its correction `5916211005` and the ACCEPT `5917498872`; the at-tier record `5917470646` on PR #20908 (its ③ OQ2 paragraph); PR #20934 (body, 9-file list, net diff `origin/main...` head at merge-base `d78a0bda07`); the check-runs on the head; objectstack `origin/main` (`87847a27ce`: `field.form.ts`, `object.form.ts`, `field.zod.ts`, `liveness/field.json`, the reconciliation test, the two pinned tests, the four catalogs and the three source-hash tables, `check-i18n-bundles.mjs`, both `package.json` `files[]`, `.objectui-sha`, PR #20428's changeset at `ec292cf599`); objectui at the pin `db11afd4967cd9d39381c5e21dc2deec9d706204` by `git show PIN:PATH` (`SchemaForm.tsx`, `widgets.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx`, `SchemaForm.requiredMarker-10367.test.tsx`). Nothing built, run or re-run. The driverless `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main refs/review/pr20934` was the one allowed probe: clean, tree `92dda44186`, and the three `main` commits past the merge base (`67c1b11a20`, `aaad682dbc`, `87847a27ce`) touch none of the nine files.

**Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-09-30T20:40:34Z:** 34; 27 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` — path-conditional skips; `.objectui-sha` is unchanged, so the pin gate has nothing to build), 4 `in_progress` (`Test Core` shards 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6), 0 failures. `Lint & Repo Gates` (which carries `check:generated`, `check:i18n`, `check:api-surface` and `check:authorable-surface`), `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec property liveness`, `Build Core`, `Test Core` 1/6 and 2/6, all four `Type Check` jobs and the `TypeScript Type Check` rollup, `Dogfood Regression Gate` 3/3 and its rollup, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`, and the four PR-shape guards (`The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`) are `success`. The four open shards are the last readers of the three moved pins in CI; their conclusions are the gate verdicts when they land, and the queue guard admits nothing before every check is green.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set: none moves. `field.zod.ts:1316` (`useGrouping: z.boolean().optional().describe(...)`) is untouched; no `*.zod.ts`, no liveness row, no export moves (`packages/spec/json-schema/` is gitignored and regenerated from the Zod; `check:generated` and `check:api-surface` ride `Lint & Repo Gates`, green on the head). What moves is the form payload `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` serves through `getMetaTypes()` (shipped in `@objectstack/spec` `dist`) and catalog content in `@objectstack/platform-objects` `dist`.

1. **The omit row deletion — RIGHT.** The hunk deletes exactly the seven-line `{ kind: 'omit', type: 'field', path: ROOT_PATH, key: 'useGrouping', why: 'declared, not enforced yet ...' }` entry at main `:387-393`, 0 insertions, nothing else. `liveness/field.json` on `origin/main` `:196-197` reads `"useGrouping": { "status": "live", "verifiedAt": "2026-09-30", "evidenceScope": "cross-repo" }`. The file's own rule at `:307-309` ("Once a key is enforced its row is stale: delete it and decide the offer then") is followed, not re-reasoned, and the dev's control pair (`699517cfb9` red with the gate's own `field.(root): accepted by the Zod but unauthorable in the form` message, `75773930ed` green) is the top-level zod-only direction behaving as designed.

2. **The `field.form.ts` row — RIGHT, and its face is the only one the form system has at the pin.** `{ field: 'useGrouping', visibleWhen: "data.type == 'number'", helpText: ... }`, no `widget`, no `type`, directly after `scale`, which carries the identical gate. Rendering, read in `SchemaForm.tsx` at the pin: `inferWidget` (`:337`) sees no explicit widget and no `fieldSpec.type`, so the JSON-schema branch at `:417` returns `'switch'` for `type === 'boolean'`; the icon / color / condition / secret / field-ref detectors (`:566`, `:579`, `:809`, `:826`) each require `admitsString` (`:500-516`: a `string` type or a union arm of one) or a `password`/`writeOnly` format, so none fires on a boolean node. `resolveFieldFace` (`:668`): `'switch'` is not a `WIDGETS` key (`widgets.tsx:2934-2954`, 20 registrations, none boolean) but is in `KNOWN_PASSTHROUGH_WIDGETS` (`:230-237`), so the scalar chain at `:723-733` returns `{ kind: 'scalar' }` on `effectiveType === 'boolean'`. `FieldControl` `:2151-2160` renders a `Switch` with `checked={!!value}` whose `onCheckedChange` handler is the only call to `onChange(c)`. `SchemaForm.requiredMarker-10367.test.tsx:58-70` renders a bare `{ type: 'boolean' }` property as `role="switch"`. The standalone `field` type has no curated home inspector (the pin registers `registerMetadataDefaultInspector` for action, dashboard, dataset, hook, object, page, report and view only), so `ResourceEditPage` renders `entry.form` through `SchemaForm` (`:2850-2861`). No extra wiring — the card's premise 3 holds.

   **Two-state face on a three-state key — acceptable, and the help text carries the load.** (a) Measured, not assumed: the form system offers no tri-state control for an optional boolean. `WIDGETS` has none; the select faces (`SchemaForm.tsx:2091-2130`) write `onChange(v)` with `v` a string, which `z.boolean()` refuses; and a row's `options[].value` is `SelectOptionSchema`'s `SystemIdentifierSchema` ("lowercase machine identifier", `field.zod.ts:337`; `FormSelectOptionSchema` at `view.zod.ts:3029-3034` reuses that shape), so a boolean cannot be spelled as an option at all. Across the registered forms on main the census is 15 `widget:` spellings and 14 `type:` spellings, none tri-state; the 33 `type: 'boolean'` rows and every plain boolean row (`allowCreate`, `exportCsv`) take this same Switch. The one tri-state select in objectui (`ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx:166`, "— / True / False" for a boolean field's *default value*) is a curated inspector control, not a `defineForm` face a row can name. So the alternative is a new objectui widget registration — outside this card's surface and outside the flight's rule of copying a row a registered form already has. The `userActions` composite's own comment (`object.form.ts:656-658`) records the identical bound and resolves it the same way. (b) The help text is accurate at the pin. "An untouched switch writes nothing": the Switch writes only from `onCheckedChange`; SchemaForm seeds nothing on mount (the only `schema.default` read, `:1703`, feeds the required-star; the node has no default anyway) and `setField` (`:1046-1051`) deletes a key only on `undefined`/`''`; `handleCreateAwareChange` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:557-570`) only marks touched keys; `doSave` (`:1445-1466`) in edit mode sends `config.fromDraft ? config.fromDraft(draft) : draft`, the draft as loaded, so an absent key stays absent on the wire. "It reads off even where the renderer groups": `checked={!!value}` reads `undefined` as off. "Unset: the renderer decides": `shouldGroupDisplayNumber` at the pin answers an authored boolean first and otherwise `scale !== 0` — the `.describe()`'s own words. And the Acceptance note's bound is true: the Switch can emit only `true`/`false`, so once toggled, unset is reachable again only through the Source tab. Nothing advertises what the runtime does not deliver — both writable states are enforced at the seven display surfaces the ledger row names.

3. **The object form's `fields` repeater is not mirrored — RIGHT to leave it.** `object.fields` is a `subset` ledger entry (`:209-213`: a quick-add grid; "the full per-field editor is `field.form.ts`"), so the nested direction owes nothing, and the ruling scoped the offer to one boolean control on the `number` field form.

4. **Pins — RIGHT, and each follows from exactly this one row.** (a) `validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` 82 → 83: the census counts every `visibleWhen`/`visibleOn` string or `{ source }` object (`:520-531`); the diff's only `*.form.ts` hunk adds one row with one `visibleWhen` string, so +1. 57 → 58: the rewrite anchors on `(==|!=)` followed by a single-quoted literal (`:667-671`); `data.type == 'number'` matches once, so +1 (an `in`-list gate would not have moved it). The comment names the true merge base `d78a0bda07`. (b) `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` 658 → 659: the control counts en `.label` leaves whose locale value differs (`:1101`); the one new label leaf `metadataForms.field.fields.useGrouping.label` is "Use Grouping" in en (generator-derived from the key, as "Allow Create" is) and 千位分隔符 / 桁区切り / Separador de miles in the three locales, so +1 in each; `helpText` leaves do not enter this count. `field-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` rightly did not move: neither new leaf equals its en source.

5. **Catalogs — RIGHT.** The four files' headers name `os i18n extract`; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` is the route AGENTS.md's table names for the nine bundle sets, and the four hunks are structure-identical (one `useGrouping: { label, helpText }` block after `scale` at `:583`). Provenance, read on the branch: `b9a8778e0b` added two `metadataForms.field.fields.useGrouping.*` digest rows per locale to the three `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` (the extractor-fill claim, digests `ac793405441ca0ab` / `95a35c561c81aff0`), `7fea903c24` removed exactly those six rows, and `git diff origin/main refs/review/pr20934 -- '*.source-hashes*'` is empty. Restored as claimed, and that is the table header's own rule: an entry exists only while the leaf is a byte copy. Translations, checked for meaning: **zh-CN** 千位分隔符 (thousands separator) / "显示值时的数字分组（千位分隔符）。未设置：由渲染端决定；未改动过的开关不写入任何值，所以即使渲染端会分组，它也显示为关闭。关闭：从不分组，例如年份或 ID。开启：始终分组。" renders all four en clauses faithfully; the switch clause is the zh-CN `userActions.helpText`'s own sentence, 未设置 is the catalog's "Unset" (22 uses) and 渲染端 its majority "renderer" (6, against 3 渲染器). **ja-JP** 桁区切り (digit grouping) / "表示する値の桁区切り（3 桁ごとの区切り記号）。未設定の場合はレンダラーが決めます。一度も操作していないスイッチは何も書き込まないため、レンダラーが区切る場合でもオフと表示されます。オフ：区切りません（例：年や ID）。オン：常に区切ります。" — faithful; 未設定 (24), レンダラー (9), and the switch clause is the ja `userActions` sentence. **es-ES** "Separador de miles" / "Agrupación de dígitos (separador de miles) en los valores mostrados. Sin definir: lo decide el renderizador; un interruptor que no se ha tocado no escribe nada, así que aparece desactivado aunque el renderizador agrupe. Desactivado: nunca se agrupa, p. ej., un año o un ID. Activado: siempre se agrupa." — faithful; "Sin definir" (19), "renderizador" (9), and the switch clause is the es `userActions` sentence. The labels translate the concept rather than the identifier "Use Grouping" — right for a switch label, and the choice the neighbouring `scale` label already made (小数位 / 小数桁 / Decimales).

6. **PR shape.** Head repo is the base repo (not a fork); draft; base `main`; first line `Fixes #20920`, then `Clause-②: no`, no other closing keyword; assignee `os-warren`; the stored body is 9245 bytes as the report says. No governed surface among the nine paths; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. The record is owed by the claim's review face (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test), not by tier.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20920-use-grouping-form-row.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **minor**, `@objectstack/platform-objects` **patch** — **RIGHT**. `packages/spec` `files[]` ships `dist`, where the compiled `field.form.ts` and `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` live, so `skip-changeset` would be wrong; the served form payload gains an authoring control, an additive and backwards-compatible feature, which is `minor` — the level PR #20428 (`ec292cf599`, `.changeset/19332-g1b-field-action-form-rows.md`: spec minor, platform-objects patch, Clause-② no) took for the same shape, and one row is not a smaller kind of change than sixteen: the level names what a consumer gains, not the diff size. `platform-objects` ships `dist` only, and what changed there is catalog content — `patch`.

`Clause-②: no` — **RIGHT**, in the PR body and in the changeset body, with no `(widening)` / `(narrowing)` arm. The Zod node is byte-unchanged, so no accept or refuse outcome moves. The changeset states "No schema accept set moves and no export changes", carries no model id and no tracker number in prose. `Check Changeset` success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none — nothing to answer or escalate.

`out_of_scope_findings` (1), a two-state switch on a three-state key, carrier none — **acceptable as noted; no card owed.** Judged under ① item 2: nothing is refused or dropped, both writable states are enforced, unset stays reachable (untouched, or in Source), and a tri-state face would be a new objectui widget registration — a feature, not a defect — with no registered form carrying one to copy. Not escalated.

`deviations`:
- First full build stopped at 66 s and re-run; first gate union stopped at 9 of 86 and re-run from scratch at the head — **informational**: the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts of record.
- Help text longer than the neighbouring rows — **right**: the added clause is load-bearing because the face cannot show unset, its wording is the `object.form.ts` `userActions` sentence verbatim, and each locale's leaf carries that locale's authored sentence for the same fact.
- `origin/main` three commits past the base, not merged in — **verified**: disjoint from the nine files; merge-tree clean.

Attribution (the report's summary): all seven branch commits carry `Claude-Session:` and the model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailer that AGENTS.md's commit rule requires; the PR body ends in the session-URL footer once; a model-id grep over the net diff finds none — **right**, AGENTS.md wins over the harness reminder.

Writes: `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes: 3` (pr_create, the assignee, the report comment), each through the fleet relay — consistent with what the PR and card show.

Claim surface: all nine files are inside claim `5918207557`'s surface; the two pinned tests are "the echo-decision / predicate-path tests ... only where a new row forces a line", and both lines were forced pins measured red first.

Card acceptance: the omit row deleted, not re-reasoned; a `useGrouping` row beside `scale` with `scale`'s gate and the `.describe()`'s three-state semantics in its help text; the catalogs regenerated by the generator with the six non-en leaves hand-authored; premises re-measured at `d78a0bda07`. Met.
